description: Change an alert from get_alert: its lines, window, timing, severity, recipients (workspace members) and channels (saved ids or "#name" in the connected Slack). Or hold its news with snoozeMinutes (0 ends a snooze; a week at most). What it reads and what it alerts on are fixed; switching an alert off or deleting it is a person's, in Vinktar. Only change an alert when the user asked.

channels.description: Where it posts: saved channel ids from get_alert, or a Slack channel of the connected Slack as "#name".

compare.description: change: against the window before (default) or the same time a week ago.

direction.description: threshold: above (default), below, at_least, at_most, outside or inside a range. change and anomaly: up, down or either (default).

environment.description: Error alerts: only this environment, e.g. "production". Omit for all.

everyMinutes.description: How often it is checked. Default 1 for error alerts, 5 for number alerts.

links.description: Links shown with every message, e.g. the team's runbook page: a label and an http or https URL each. Replaces the list.

minLevel.description: Error alerts: the least severe level that counts.

name.description: What it alerts on, as a person would say it: "Signups dropping", "New issues in production".

notifyTeam.description: Also tell the owners and admins. Default: on when no recipients or channels are given.

pendingFor.description: Consecutive checks in breach before it fires, so one bad minute is not news. Default 1.

percent.description: change: how far it has to move, in percent. Default 50.

recipients.description: Workspace members to email, by address. Outside addresses are refused: a person adds those in Vinktar.

reducer.description: Number alerts: how the window's buckets become one value. Default sum.

release.description: Error alerts: only issues last seen on this release; a trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. "web@2.*".

sensitivity.description: anomaly: standard deviations from its last 24 windows that count as unusual. Default 3.

severity.description: How urgent its news is. Default warning.

spikeMinCount.description: spike: a floor, so a quiet issue going from 1 to 4 is not a spike (default 50). occurrences, users_affected: the line (default 100).

spikeMultiplier.description: spike only: how many times the baseline counts as a spike. Default 3.

spikeWindowMinutes.description: spike, occurrences, users_affected: the window in minutes. Default 10 for spike, 60 otherwise.

textContains.description: Error alerts: only issues whose title, type or culprit contains this.

threshold.description: threshold: the line (the bottom of the range for outside and inside).

upperThreshold.description: threshold with outside or inside: the top of the range.

windowMinutes.description: Number alerts: the trailing window in minutes. Default 60.

name: update_alert
title: Update alert
